answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil identities by requiring each account to lock a refundable bond before its votes or service claims count. A bridge from identity to influence checks that stake, while a ripple of coordinated duplicate claims triggers randomized audits; proven shared control forfeits the bonds. Honest agents recover theirs, but an attacker must finance every fake account and loses audited stakes, making a hollow swarm costly to maintain.
